text:
harper: Heads-up: target rollforward to runtime 2.24 tonight 21:45 UTC. Contains kernel reorder + kv-pointer fix. Need quick pin/unpin call for embed/vec and longseq families.

zane: Canary looks OK overall but p95 up ~6% for vec-quant on first token windows. No OOMs.

mina: Suggest soft-pin vec-embed/* -> 2.23 for 5h post-roll. Longseq can move to 2.24 but watch tiny-batch warmup.

ops-oncall: Recommend deadman revert at 01:15 UTC. Auto-revert if 5xx > 1.5% or p95 increase > 25% sustained 10m. Page release owners on trigger.

deploybot: Automated: snapshotting pinlist at 21:15 UTC. Preview diff:
```
- runtime_pin: 2.23 -> models: [assistant-lite/*]
+ runtime_pin: 2.24 -> models: [fast-sampler/*]
+ soft_pin: vec-embed/* -> runtime:2.23 until 02:15 UTC
```

harper: Decision: apply soft_pin for vec-embed/* only. Action items:
- zane: paste canary repro + minimal prompt by 21:30.
- mina: update release notes with SDK 3.8 fallback snippet by 21:30.
- deploybot: apply soft_pin at 21:15 and publish pin diff to /releases/2.24/pins.
- ops-oncall: enable deadman revert at 01:15 UTC.

zane: Repro prompt: `condense(long_meeting_notes)` shows first-chunk latency spike at batch_size=1. Attaching flamegraph to PR.

docs-bot: Suggested release note blurb: "If you rely on vec-embed quantized models, consider setting runtime_preference: [\"2.24\", \"2.23\"] to allow graceful fallback."

mina: For SDK note, add client example in release notes and mention graceful fallback behavior.

deploybot: Confirmed: soft_pin applied at 21:15 UTC. Pin diff published. Rollforward scheduled 21:45 UTC. Logs: https://infra.ci/deploys/2.24/3601234567

ops-oncall: Running targeted smoke for vec-embed pipelines post-roll. Will page if thresholds breached.

harper: If anyone observes correctness regressions in canary, post examples here and tag me. We'll hold additional unpins until 08:00 UTC.

zane: Follow-up: traced a small hotspot in kv_refresh() under micro-batches. Not blocking but filing INF-5017.

deploybot: Automated: rollforward started 21:45 UTC. Will post success/failure updates to #release-ops.

ops-oncall: Post-rollcheck at 22:10 UTC in #release-ops. I'll run a 10-min smoke that simulates embed pipelines.

harper: Thanks all. Compat brake in place. :thumbsup:
